C. A. 8th Cir. (Certiorari granted, 390 U. S. 1002.) Motion of petitioner for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Bruce R. Jacob, Esquire, of Atlanta, Georgia, a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
